test_case.test_name: Parameterized MLPerf v3.0 BERT99 Server compliant validation
test_case.purpose: Produce a valid v3.0 BERT99 Server result and compare it with a matched MLCommons v3.0 system/reference.
required_package: Comparable v3.0 reference and approved delta
test_case.test_command: Validate v3.0 hashes/licenses, BERT99 assets and GPU health; execute the supported equivalent of `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=bert --scenarios=server"`; run accuracy and Server performance/LoadGen validity stages; preserve detail/summary, accuracy, throughput/P99 and telemetry; restore state and compare only with the matched v3.0 BERT99 Server reference.
test_case.expected_result: BERT99 accuracy and Server validity pass, performance meets the approved delta and the platform remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact v3.0 BERT99 Server identity, approved profile, accuracy/validity and threshold. Offline, invalid, unmatched or thresholdless results cannot pass.
safety_gate: Use licensed hashed v3.0 BERT artifacts.
Verify Server profile before long run.
Preserve all logs; no official-submission claim.
expected_evidence: Accuracy and LoadGen Server validity logs
test_case.recovery: On BERT accuracy failure, Server latency invalidity or GPU-memory pressure, stop the exact container, retain LoadGen/model/memory evidence, restore captured runtime and power settings, and verify GPU memory/driver health before any separately approved repeat.
